$comment: DEFINED EVENTS. Five events, all first-party, all aggregate. No user identifier is stored for any of them. The client beacon is inert until an endpoint is configured (see Q-06).
privacy_stance: No cookie. No localStorage. No IP storage. No user agent. No session id. No cross-site pixel. Each event is an aggregate counter keyed only by page path and, for outbound clicks, product id and day.

events.name: outbound_click
events.fires_when: A reader activates an outbound Amazon control. Fired on a real activation; the browser performs the navigation itself.
events.note: Not a redirect. The anchor's href is the Amazon URL. This keeps the site clear of the Redirecting Link and URL-obscuring rules (S08, S09).

events.name: guide_read
events.fires_when: A reader reaches the end of a guide.

events.name: record_open
events.fires_when: A reader opens a records or flagged-for-review page.
events.note: Useful for telling apart buyer traffic from review traffic.

events.name: suggestion_decide
events.fires_when: An owner marks a suggestion accepted, rejected, or deferred on the suggestions page.
events.note: Design intent: this records the decision locally in the browser only. No server write is implied.
